name: Sergeant-at-Conkers
text: Start of Combat: throw your smallest Larder item across. That enemy loses a tenth of its stats per gold.
golden_text: Start of Combat: throw your two smallest Larder items across. That enemy loses a tenth of its stats per gold.

source.note: Pass 3; amended tribe gates and provisional paper B/C rates in content/pass3/rates.json.

details: Spends the smallest Larder item for each throw. Losses round down, to at least 0 Attack and 1 Health. With no enemy across, keep the item. Golden throws resolve separately.
golden_details: Spends the smallest Larder item for each throw. Losses round down, to at least 0 Attack and 1 Health. With no enemy across, keep the item. Golden throws resolve separately.
